observations: updateAmbrForSession updates both uplink and downlink session limits from sessionAmbr.
handleUplinkData and handleUdpReceive consult allowUplinkPacket and allowDownlinkPacket respectively before forwarding.
handleUplinkData takes the QFI from qosFlows list element zero. This source does not demonstrate uplink per-application QFI selection.
RateLimiter maintains per-UE and per-session buckets in both directions.
Packets are admitted only when the applicable TokenBucket::tryConsume calls succeed.
These limiters do not reference the Linux gtp5g /proc QoS switch.

interpretation: The simulator gNB is a confounder for isolating gtp5g Session-AMBR policing using endpoint throughput. The runtime image version matches the inspected release, but the upstream source is not a rebuilt attestation of the installed executable.
scope: Source inspection supports mechanism interpretation; runtime rate effect and installed rule values require separate evidence. No radio scheduler or dedicated-flow acceptance follows.
